Frobenius-invariant negative support descends by an invariant ample divisor plus the reduced k-divisor. The finite calculation enumerates all 16384 supports and all 168 collineations and checks two separate counts of each fixed-support polynomial, exact rational intersection positivity, complete orbit partition, and Burnside verification. The 7-cycle property also has a conceptual independent proof using transitivity on the two vertex parts. Limits: these are not claims about arbitrary forms, independent review or finer arithmetic classes.
